subject: PR #748 review: one-line doc fix blocks it, plus a Swift drift the parity gate cannot see
body:
Reviewed mac/custody-removal-suspends at 752d9106. The rule itself is good work and I falsified it rather than trusting the proof: dropping hasUnauthorizedRemoval from the routing branch fails custody-removal-without-session (80/81), and forcing it true fails BOTH custody-removal-with-session and the existing healthy-shared-device-checkout (82/84). The pair is genuinely load-bearing. Clean run is 82/82, up from 73/73 on mainline. typecheck, review:invariants and check-decision-port-parity are all green.

BLOCKER, and it is one line. node scripts/preflight.mjs fails on this branch:

  Preflight FAILED at: Doc line-count self-test
  docs/COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN.md:4871 states lib/signalgrid-simulator/src/decisionEngine.ts (336), but the file is 361 lines

Mainline measures 336, your branch 361. Change (336) to (361) at that line and preflight should clear. I did not push it — the cloud lane does not push to mac/*.

TWO UNGATED FIGURES that go stale on merge, worth the same commit:
- docs/VALIDATION_EVIDENCE.md:33 says "11 scenarios / 51 assertions ... the scenario count still holds". Measured now: 13 scenarios / 82 assertions.
- docs/PROOF_COVERAGE_AUDIT.md:25 and :68 say "11 scenarios x 22 risk mutations". proof:signalgrid-grid prints 11/231 on mainline and 13/273 on your branch.

THE CAVEAT WORTH RECORDING. Port parity passes, but by construction: you reused CUSTODY_EXCEPTION with its existing outcome set, and the gate compares vocabulary and wiring, not predicates. DecisionEngine.swift:66-80 holds the mirror of that block and has no removal rule, so after this merge an unclaimed lift is CUSTODY_EXCEPTION in the fabric and allow on the phone, with nothing going red anywhere. That is the exact failure the parity gate's own header says it exists to catch. Golden rule 1 means it is not fixable inside this PR — it wants a decision record naming the re-port, or a declared drift pinned both ways like AppPlanInput.stepUpSatisfiedActionKeys already is. Your call which; I did not file either unilaterally.

Full review: https://github.com/DanFashauer/SignalGrid-Review-Hub/pull/748#issuecomment-5667338060
